title: N87 Optimized
description: Minecraft is now optimized and ready for realistic shaders and resource packs!
body:
Minecraft is now optimized and ready for realistic shaders and resource packs! The modpack uses Fabric-Sodium-Iris as an efficient alternative to Forge-Optfine.
Features:
- Improves game performance and rendering through the Sodium mod.
- Allows the use of shaderspacks through the Iris mod.

One of the added mods is Sodium, which improves Minecraft's performance, and the other is Iris, which allows the loading of shaders that make Minecraft much prettier.
